paragraphs: R' Tanhum, who was saved from a lions' den after defeating the emperor in argument: Sanhedrin 39a. And R.E. of Tzada'a in R' Aha's name. He said in R' Assi's name: Berakhot 29a; in R' Assi's name, who said in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name: there, side b. He said in R' Birim's name. R' Gada was his attendant. He said in R' Tavla's name, who said in R' Beruna's name: Sanhedrin 28b. He said in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name: Berakhot 6b; there, 28b, two matters; Sotah 39b, several matters. R' Tanhum and R' Birim in an elder's name—who? R' Yehoshua ben Levi: Bava Kamma 81a, 82a. R' Manu of Tyre was in his time. Rav Natan bar Minyomi reports in his name. R' Panda said in R' Tanhum's name; see above, Bizna. He spoke to Rav Pappa bar Rav Aha bar Adda. He expounded Bar Kappara. He objected to R' Shmuel bar Abba. R' Tanhum is buried in the town Tanhum: גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael]. I do not know which R' Tanhum.
